newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks up in late trade on electronics.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks up in late trade on electronics.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were higher in late Wednesday trade as electronics surged to support the market, though brokers saw continued near-term consolidation.
With 35 minutes left, or 0325 GMT, the index was up 42.45 points or 0.53 percent at 8,039.20. Turnover was T$50 billion.
Electronics surged 2.35 percent, with chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor up T$3.5 to T$104.5.
"Most still expect electronics, especially semiconductor shares, to perform strongly in sales and profits in coming quarters," said HSBC James Capel analyst Alex Chen.
"But recent political uncertainties triggered by worries about (Taiwan's) social disorder, though are easing, should still keep investors on the sidelines in the near term," he said.
Chen said he expected the index to consolidate between 7,800 and 8,200 in coming sessions.
